Four merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `doFilterInternal` under `web/src/main/java`. Listed newest first:

1. **#6680** (TRUNK-6826, "Request paths with a trailing slash find no handler on core 3.0"), merged 2026-10-13. Adds `doFilterInternal` in `web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/TrailingSlashFilter.java:54`.
2. **#6673** (TRUNK-6824, "Request paths with a repeated slash fail with 500 on core 3.0"), merged 2026-10-12. Adds `doFilterInternal` in `web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/RepeatedSlashFilter.java:50`.
3. **#6544** (TRUNK-6799, "Introduce Spring Security with support for legacy authentication context"), merged 2026-10-08. Adds and removes `doFilterInternal` in Javadoc `@see` lines of `web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/security/OpenmrsSecurityContextFilter.java:50,54`. These are comment lines, but they contain the term.
4. **#6505** (TRUNK-6705, "Reduce the overhead of the gzip filter"), merged 2026-08-26. Adds and removes the method signature in `web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/GZIPFilter.java:46,48`.

Excluded: **#6555** (TRUNK-6701, merged 2026-09-11) also touches `doFilterInternal`, but only under `web/src/test/java`, so it does not count.

Caveats:
- The search ran against HEAD, the default-branch metadata was empty, and I did not check first-parent history separately. The commits were all squash-style PR merges on the main line.
- The dates are commit dates from Falkon, which I took as the merge dates.
- Falkon only accepted the repository as `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-core`, not the bare name.
